info.title: Sim Tables API v2
info.description: Version 2 of the Sim REST API for tables, typed columns, rows, saved views, workflow groups, folders, imports, and exports. Row data is keyed by column name.

tags.name: Tables
tags.description: Manage tables, columns, rows, views, runs, folders, imports, and exports.

get.description:
List tables in a workspace with optional folder filtering, search, sorting, and an opaque cursor envelope. `scope=archived` lists tables a `DELETE` archived, which `POST /api/v2/tables/{tableId}/restore` can bring back. A workspace folder tree over 10,000 folders is a `413`.

OAuth scope: `api:read`.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Workspace whose tables should be listed.

schema.description: Workspace whose tables should be listed.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Which lifecycle set to list: `active` (default) for live tables, `archived` for tables a delete archived and a table restore can bring back. `folderPath` resolves against active folders only, so pairing it with `scope=archived` returns an empty page when the containing folder was archived too.

schema.description: Which lifecycle set to list: `active` (default) for live tables, `archived` for tables a delete archived and a table restore can bring back. `folderPath` resolves against active folders only, so pairing it with `scope=archived` returns an empty page when the containing folder was archived too.

parameters.name: folderPath
parameters.description: Restrict results to tables in this folder. A path that names no folder narrows the result to nothing, so the response is an empty page rather than an error.

schema.description: Restrict results to tables in this folder. A path that names no folder narrows the result to nothing, so the response is an empty page rather than an error.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring match against the resource name.

schema.description: Case-insensitive substring match against the resource name.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Field used to sort the result. Sorting by `name` is case-sensitive and follows the storage collation, so do not rely on a case-insensitive order.

schema.description: Field used to sort the result. Sorting by `name` is case-sensitive and follows the storage collation, so do not rely on a case-insensitive order.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum tables to return per page. Values outside 1–1000 are truncated and clamped into that range rather than rejected. Defaults to 100.

schema.description: Maximum tables to return per page. Values outside 1–1000 are truncated and clamped into that range rather than rejected. Defaults to 100.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page. Send it back with the same sort and filters; only `limit` may change. Change anything else and pagination must restart without a cursor.

schema.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page. Send it back with the same sort and filters; only `limit` may change. Change anything else and pagination must restart without a cursor.

200.description: A page of tables in the workspace.

post.description:
Create a table with a typed column schema and optional folder placement.

OAuth scope: `api:write`.

requestBody.description: Workspace, table metadata, folder placement, and typed columns.

get.description:
Retrieve a table with its metadata, column schema, locks, and current job. A workspace folder tree over 10,000 folders is a `413`.

OAuth scope: `api:read`.

delete.description:
Archive a table and return an explicit deletion acknowledgement. The table is soft-deleted, not erased: its rows are retained and `POST /api/v2/tables/{tableId}/restore` brings it back.

OAuth scope: `api:write`.

patch.description:
Rename a table, edit its description, or move it to a canonical folder. At least one mutable field is required; lock flags are read-only.

NOT atomic: fields are written independently, so a 4xx may follow a partial update. When fields were applied, `details.applied` names them; retry only the missing fields. If it is absent, nothing changed.

A workspace folder tree over 10,000 folders is a `413`.

OAuth scope: `api:write`.

requestBody.description: Workspace scope and one or more table metadata or placement changes.

post.description:
Add a typed column and return the complete resulting table schema.

OAuth scope: `api:write`.

requestBody.description: Workspace scope and the typed column to add.

patch.description:
Update a column by name and return the complete resulting table schema.

OAuth scope: `api:write`.

requestBody.description: Workspace scope, current column name, and fields to update.

delete.description:
Delete a column by name while preserving at least one table column.

OAuth scope: `api:write`.

requestBody.description: Workspace scope and column name to delete.

get.description:
List a plain cursor page in default row order. Pages are capped at 5MB by default and may contain fewer rows than the requested limit; continue until nextCursor is null. Use the query endpoint for predicate filtering and sorting. Set `includeRunState=true` to attach each row's per-workflow-group run outcomes; the row limit is capped when it is set.

OAuth scope: `api:read`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum rows to return per page. Must be a whole number from 1 to 1000. Defaults to 100.

schema.description: Maximum rows to return per page. Must be a whole number from 1 to 1000. Defaults to 100.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page. Send it back with the same sort and filters; only `limit` may change. Change anything else and pagination must restart without a cursor.

schema.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page. Send it back with the same sort and filters; only `limit` may change. Change anything else and pagination must restart without a cursor.

parameters.name: includeRunState
parameters.description: Include per-workflow-group run state on every returned row. Off by default: run state is a separate sidecar read and its `blockErrors` are unbounded, so a full page carries it only when asked. Caps `limit` at 200.

schema.description: Include per-workflow-group run state on every returned row. Off by default: run state is a separate sidecar read and its `blockErrors` are unbounded, so a full page carries it only when asked. Caps `limit` at 200.

post.description:
Insert one row with a data object or insert a bounded batch with a rows array. Cell keys are column names.

OAuth scope: `api:write`.

requestBody.description: A single row or bounded row batch keyed by column name.

patch.description:
Apply the same partial data patch to every row matching a non-empty predicate.

OAuth scope: `api:write`.

requestBody.description: Workspace scope, typed predicate, and row-data patch.

delete.description:
Delete rows by a non-empty predicate or an explicit bounded list of row identifiers.

OAuth scope: `api:write`.

requestBody.description: Workspace scope and exactly one of a predicate or row identifier list.

get.description:
Retrieve one row by identifier. Set `includeRunState=true` to attach the row's per-workflow-group run outcomes.

OAuth scope: `api:read`.

parameters.name: includeRunState
parameters.description: Include per-workflow-group run state on the returned row. Off by default.

schema.description: Include per-workflow-group run state on the returned row. Off by default.

patch.description:
Merge a partial data patch into one row by identifier.

OAuth scope: `api:write`.

requestBody.description: Workspace scope and row-data patch keyed by column name.

delete.description:
Delete one row by identifier.

OAuth scope: `api:write`.

post.description:
Insert a row or update the existing row that conflicts on a selected unique column.

WARNING — the update branch REPLACES the row, it does not merge. `data` is the complete new row value, so every column you omit is cleared on the matched row. Send the full row here, or use `PATCH /api/v2/tables/{tableId}/rows/{rowId}` to change a subset.

OAuth scope: `api:write`.

requestBody.description: Workspace scope, row data, and optional unique-column conflict target.

200.description: The upserted row and operation performed.

post.description:
Query rows using an optional typed condition or `all`/`any` group, ordered sorting, and opaque cursor pagination. Omit the predicate to match all rows. Pages default to a 5 MB cap and may return fewer rows than requested; continue until `nextCursor` is null. Oversized predicates return `413`. `includeRunState` adds per-group outcomes and lowers the row cap. Counts come from a separate snapshot at `POST /query/count`; take the count first and treat it as a floor.

OAuth scope: `api:read`.

requestBody.description: Workspace scope, optional predicate and sort, and cursor pagination controls. The predicate may be one condition or an `all`/`any` group; omitting it matches every row.

200.description: A page of matching table rows.

post.description:
Count the rows matching a typed predicate across the entire table. A predicate may be one condition or an `all`/`any` group. The paged reads carry no total, and `rowCount` on the table resource counts every row rather than the matches. Omit the predicate to count the whole table. A predicate larger than the request-body ceiling is a `413`.

OAuth scope: `api:read`.

requestBody.description: Workspace scope and the optional condition or `all`/`any` predicate group whose matches are counted.

200.description: The number of matching table rows.

get.description:
List the bounded set of saved table views, with references to removed columns pruned on read. The bounded set is returned in one page; `nextCursor` is always null.

OAuth scope: `api:read`.

post.description:
Save a filter, sort, and column layout as a named presentation of a table.

OAuth scope: `api:write`.

requestBody.description: Workspace scope, name, and saved filter, sort, and layout configuration.

get.description:
Retrieve one saved table view by identifier.

OAuth scope: `api:read`.

patch.description:
Rename a view, replace or shallow-merge its configuration, or promote it to the table default.

OAuth scope: `api:write`.

requestBody.description: Workspace scope and one or more saved-view changes.

delete.description:
Delete a saved presentation without changing any table rows.

OAuth scope: `api:write`.

get.description:
List the workflow and enrichment groups that can be dispatched for a table. The bounded set is returned in one page; `nextCursor` is always null.

OAuth scope: `api:read`.

post.description:
Bind a workflow or enrichment to the table and create the columns populated by its outputs.

OAuth scope: `api:write`.

requestBody.description: Workspace scope, producer definition, and output columns.

201.description: The created workflow group and resulting columns.

patch.description:
Restructure a workflow group, its producer, outputs, or execution behavior. Repointing the group at a different workflow concurrently invalidates the resolved output types and returns `409` — retry the update.

OAuth scope: `api:write`.

requestBody.description: Workspace scope, workflow group identifier, and producer changes.

200.description: The updated workflow group and resulting columns.

delete.description:
Delete a workflow group and every table column populated by that group.

OAuth scope: `api:write`.

requestBody.description: Workspace scope and workflow group identifier.

200.description: Workflow-group deletion acknowledgement and surviving columns.

post.description:
Asynchronously run workflow or enrichment groups across all rows or a selected row subset. Poll the returned `dispatchId` with `GET /api/v2/tables/{tableId}/dispatches/{dispatchId}` until its status is `complete` or `canceled`, and cancel it with `DELETE` on the same path. A `null` `dispatchId` means the run settled inline and there is nothing to poll.

OAuth scope: `api:write`.

requestBody.description: Workspace scope, producer groups, execution mode, and optional row scope.

get.description:
List the run dispatches still in flight on one table. Bounded by the dispatcher rather than by a page size, so this list is unpaginated and `nextCursor` is always null. A settled dispatch is read by identifier.

OAuth scope: `api:read`.

post.description:
Asynchronously run one workflow or enrichment group for one table row. Poll the returned `dispatchId` with `GET /api/v2/tables/{tableId}/dispatches/{dispatchId}`; a `null` `dispatchId` means the cell already settled inline.

OAuth scope: `api:write`.

parameters.name: groupId
parameters.description: Workflow or enrichment group to run.

schema.description: Workflow or enrichment group to run.

requestBody.description: Workspace scope for the row enrichment.

get.description:
Retrieve the provider cascade behind one enrichment cell: every configured provider in cascade order, each one's status, hosted-key cost, and duration, plus which provider produced the match. `null` means the cell has never run, or ran before cascade detail was recorded — distinct from a `404`, which means the table, row, or group does not exist.

OAuth scope: `api:read`.

parameters.name: groupId
parameters.description: Workflow or enrichment group to run.

schema.description: Workflow or enrichment group to run.

200.description: The enrichment run detail, or null when none was recorded.

post.description:
Search every cell case-insensitively for substring `q`, optionally within a predicate-filtered, sorted view. This is text search; `POST /query` performs structured predicate reads. Results are cell coordinates `{ ordinal, rowId, column }`, never row data; `ordinal` indexes the same view paged by `POST /query`. Results are uncursored and capped at 1000; `truncated` signals more matches. Narrow `q` or the predicate instead of paging.

OAuth scope: `api:read`.

requestBody.description: Workspace scope, substring query, and optional predicate and sort.

post.description:
Create a durable CSV import. Upload sources receive signed transfer instructions; workspace-file sources begin processing directly.

OAuth scope: `api:write`.

requestBody.description: Workspace, CSV source, target table, optional mapping, and timezone.

201.description: The created table import and optional transfer instructions.

get.description:
Read progress and terminal state for a durable table import.

An upload-backed import has no durable record until its upload completes, so send the signed upload control token to read it during the `uploading` phase; without the token that phase is a `404`.

OAuth scope: `api:read`.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Workspace that owns the transfer resource.

schema.description: Workspace that owns the transfer resource.

parameters.name: upload-token
parameters.description: Signed upload control token returned when an upload-backed import was created.

schema.description: Signed upload control token returned when an upload-backed import was created.

delete.description:
Cancel an upload or processing import without rolling back committed row batches.

An import that is not in a cancelable state, including an `expired` one, is a `409` naming the current status. An unknown or already-purged import id is a `404`.

OAuth scope: `api:write`.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Workspace that owns the transfer resource.

schema.description: Workspace that owns the transfer resource.

parameters.name: upload-token
parameters.description: Signed upload control token returned when an upload-backed import was created.

schema.description: Signed upload control token returned when an upload-backed import was created.

post.description:
Issue short-lived signed PUT URLs for a bounded set of multipart part numbers.

The import must still be `uploading`; one that has moved on, including an `expired` one, is a `409` naming the current status. An unknown or already-purged import id is a `404`.

OAuth scope: `api:write`.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Workspace that owns the transfer resource.

schema.description: Workspace that owns the transfer resource.

parameters.name: upload-token
parameters.description: Signed upload control token returned when the upload session was created.

schema.description: Signed upload control token returned when the upload session was created.

requestBody.description: Multipart part numbers for which signed URLs should be created.

post.description:
Verify or assemble the uploaded CSV and begin processing with the same import id.

An import no longer awaiting an upload, including an `expired` one, is a `409` naming the current status. An unknown or already-purged import id is a `404`.

OAuth scope: `api:write`.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Workspace that owns the transfer resource.

schema.description: Workspace that owns the transfer resource.

parameters.name: upload-token
parameters.description: Signed upload control token returned when the upload session was created.

schema.description: Signed upload control token returned when the upload session was created.

200.description: The table import after upload completion.

post.description:
Create a durable CSV or JSON export that completes inline for small tables and queues larger work.

OAuth scope: `api:write`.

requestBody.description: Workspace scope and export format.

get.description:
Read progress and terminal state for a durable table export.

OAuth scope: `api:read`.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Workspace that owns the transfer resource.

schema.description: Workspace that owns the transfer resource.

delete.description:
Cancel an export that has not reached a terminal state.

OAuth scope: `api:write`.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Workspace that owns the transfer resource.

schema.description: Workspace that owns the transfer resource.

get.description:
Return a short-lived signed download URL for a completed table export.

The export must have reached `completed`; one still processing, failed, or canceled is a `409` naming the current status. An export whose file is no longer available is a `404`, not a `410`.

OAuth scope: `api:read`.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Workspace that owns the transfer resource.

schema.description: Workspace that owns the transfer resource.

post.description:
Stop in-flight and pending workflow or enrichment cell runs across the table or one selected row.

OAuth scope: `api:write`.

requestBody.description: Workspace scope, cancellation scope, and optional predicate or producer groups.

200.description: The number of canceled cell runs.

get.description:
List table folders, optionally restricting the result to direct children of a canonical parent path. The bounded set is returned in one page; `nextCursor` is always null.

OAuth scope: `api:read`.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Workspace whose folders should be listed.

schema.description: Workspace whose folders should be listed.

parameters.name: parentPath
parameters.description: Restrict results to direct children of this parent path. A path that names no folder narrows the result to nothing, so the response is an empty page rather than an error.

schema.description: Restrict results to direct children of this parent path. A path that names no folder narrows the result to nothing, so the response is an empty page rather than an error.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring match against the folder name.

schema.description: Case-insensitive substring match against the folder name.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Field used to sort the result. Sorting by `name` is case-sensitive and follows the storage collation, so do not rely on a case-insensitive order.

schema.description: Field used to sort the result. Sorting by `name` is case-sensitive and follows the storage collation, so do not rely on a case-insensitive order.

post.description:
Create one table-folder leaf whose parent path already exists.

OAuth scope: `api:write`.

requestBody.description: Workspace scope and canonical folder path to create.

patch.description:
Rename or move a table folder and update all descendant paths.

OAuth scope: `api:write`.

requestBody.description: Workspace scope, current canonical path, and destination path.

delete.description:
Delete an empty table folder, or recursively delete its descendants and tables when explicitly requested.

OAuth scope: `api:write`.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path of the folder to delete.

schema.description: Path of the folder to delete.

parameters.name: recursive
parameters.description: Delete the folder's nested files and folders too. An empty folder deletes either way; a non-empty one needs this. The listed spellings are the whole accepted vocabulary and are case-sensitive; any other value is rejected.

schema.description: Delete the folder's nested files and folders too. An empty folder deletes either way; a non-empty one needs this. The listed spellings are the whole accepted vocabulary and are case-sensitive; any other value is rejected.

post.description:
Restore a recursively archived table folder with its subfolders and tables, addressed by its former path. If its parent remains archived, it is re-rooted to `/`; active-name conflicts are deduplicated, so use the returned `path`. Non-archived paths return `404`. Preserve the path returned by `DELETE /api/v2/tables/folders`: unlike the files API, the table-folder list cannot discover archived paths.

OAuth scope: `api:write`.

requestBody.description: Workspace scope and the canonical path the archived folder held.

200.description: The restored table folder and what it brought back.

post.description:
Un-archive a table a `DELETE` archived, along with the rows, views, and workflow groups archived with it. Find archived tables with `scope=archived` on the table list. Idempotent: a table that is already active is returned unchanged with no audit entry recorded, so a retry after a dropped response cannot look like a failure. A name collision is resolved by renaming, so the restored table may come back under a different `name`.

OAuth scope: `api:write`.

requestBody.description: Workspace scope for the archived table.

post.description:
Apply a distinct partial data patch to each of up to 1000 rows in one request. Each patch merges into its row, so a column absent from `data` is left alone. Membership is atomic: a `rowId` naming no row in this table fails the whole request with a `400` listing the missing identifiers. Use `PATCH /api/v2/tables/{tableId}/rows` when one patch applies to every matching row.

OAuth scope: `api:write`.

requestBody.description: Workspace scope and one merge patch per row.

get.description:
Poll one workflow-column run dispatch by the `dispatchId` the run endpoints returned. Answers in every lifecycle state — `pending`, `dispatching`, `complete`, and `canceled` — so a poller can wait for a run to settle. Per-cell outcomes are read with `includeRunState` on the row endpoints.

OAuth scope: `api:read`.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Workspace that owns the transfer resource.

schema.description: Workspace that owns the transfer resource.

delete.description:
Cancel one run dispatch by the `dispatchId` the run endpoint returned. This stops the scheduler: the dispatcher observes the cancellation at its next iteration and enqueues no further cells. Cells already handed to the queue are NOT canceled here — nothing links a queued cell back to the dispatch that enqueued it — so use `POST /api/v2/tables/{tableId}/cancel-runs` to stop work already in flight. Idempotent: a dispatch already `complete` or `canceled` is returned unchanged.

OAuth scope: `api:write`.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Workspace that owns the transfer resource.

schema.description: Workspace that owns the transfer resource.

200.description: The dispatch in its post-cancellation state.

post.description:
Move up to 100 tables and canonical-path folders to one destination; `null` or `/` means the workspace root. Processing is best-effort per item: tables already carried by selected folders are `skipped`, missing items are `notFound`, and lock or cycle refusals are `failed` with reasons. An invalid destination rejects the entire request before any move.

OAuth scope: `api:write`.

requestBody.description: Workspace scope, the tables and folder paths to move, and the destination folder path.

200.description: Per-item outcome of the bulk move.

post.description:
Archive up to 100 tables and delete table folders in a single authorized request. Folders are named by canonical path and each cascades to everything inside it; `deletedItems` reports the totals across every cascade. Archived tables stay recoverable through `POST /api/v2/tables/{tableId}/restore`. Best-effort per item, with the same `skipped` / `notFound` / `failed` dispositions as the bulk move.

OAuth scope: `api:write`.

requestBody.description: Workspace scope, and the tables and folder paths to delete.

200.description: Per-item outcome of the bulk delete.

apiKey.name: X-API-Key
apiKey.description: Your Sim API key, personal or workspace-scoped. Generate one under Settings, then API Keys. Operations that reject workspace keys say so in their own description.

oauthBearer.description: A Sim OAuth access token obtained by a registered client through the authorization-code flow. Each operation declares its required scope: api:read permits reads and searches; api:write also permits changes and execution and implies api:read. Scope requirements follow the application operation, independent of HTTP method or workspace role.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Maximum requests allowed in the current window.

schema.title: Rate limit
schema.description: Maximum requests allowed in the current window.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests remaining in the current window.

schema.title: Rate limit remaining
schema.description: Requests remaining in the current window.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the current rate-limit window resets.

schema.title: Rate limit reset
schema.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the current rate-limit window resets.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before retrying, sent on `429` and `503`. Add jitter rather than retrying at exactly this offset.

schema.title: Retry after
schema.description: Seconds to wait before retrying, sent on `429` and `503`. Add jitter rather than retrying at exactly this offset.

X-Run-Id.description: Identifier assigned to the workflow run.

schema.title: Run identifier
schema.description: Identifier assigned to the workflow run.

BadRequest.description: The request is invalid. This includes a query parameter sent with no value (`?limit=`, `?search=`), which is rejected rather than read as zero, empty, or the parameter default — omit the parameter instead.

Unauthorized.description: The API credential is missing or invalid.

Forbidden.description: The caller lacks the rights this operation requires. When the cause is one a caller can act on, `error.details.code` names it. A resource in a workspace the caller cannot reach at all answers `404` instead, so absence and denial are indistinguishable.

NotFound.description: The requested resource was not found.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with current resource state.

error.message: A table named "Orders" already exists in this workspace

PayloadTooLarge.description: The request, or a resource collection it must materialize, exceeds the allowed size: an oversized request body, a generated artifact past the download ceiling, or a workspace folder tree too large to load in full.

UnsupportedMediaType.description: The request uses an unsupported media type.

error.message: Request body must be sent as application/json

Locked.description: The resource is temporarily locked or unavailable; retry the request.

error.message: This table is insert-locked: new rows cannot be added.

RateLimited.description: The caller exceeded the request rate limit.

ServiceUnavailable.description: A required service is temporarily unavailable. `Retry-After` carries the seconds to wait; treat it as a floor and add jitter. The header is omitted when `error.details.code` is `ASYNC_ENQUEUE_AMBIGUOUS`, because the run may already have started — reconcile against the returned run id instead of retrying.

V2ActionableForbiddenDetails.title: Actionable forbidden details
V2ActionableForbiddenDetails.description: Machine-readable cause and optional context for an actionable `403` response.

V2ForbiddenDetailCode.title: Forbidden detail code
V2ForbiddenDetailCode.description: Stable cause code for an actionable `403` response.

details.description: Structured error context whose keys depend on the error. Actionable `403` responses use the `V2ActionableForbiddenDetails` shape; validation failures may return issue arrays instead.

anyOf.description: Other structured context defined by the specific error.

V2Error.title: v2 error response
V2Error.description: Canonical error envelope returned by the public v2 API.

FolderPathInput.title: Folder path input
FolderPathInput.description: Folder path. A missing leading slash is normalized before validation. Segments are percent-encoded, so a folder shown as "New folder" is `/New%20folder`: everything outside `A-Z a-z 0-9 - _ . ~` is escaped as uppercase hex, and only that exact encoding is accepted. A trailing slash, an empty segment, and a literal `.` or `..` segment are rejected. At most 64 segments and 4096 encoded bytes.

A trailing slash, an empty segment, and a literal `.` or `..` segment are rejected. At most 64 segments and 4096 encoded bytes.

TablePredicate.title: Table predicate
TablePredicate.description: Recursive non-empty `all`/`any` groups containing groups or conditions; the root cannot be a condition. Limits: 100 members per group, 10 levels, and 500 nodes. The negating operators include nulls and absent cells, multi-select included; combine with `isNotNull` or `isNotEmpty` to exclude them. Pattern operators use `*` as the only wildcard; `%`, `_`, and backslash are literal. Select operators: single-select uses `eq`/`ne`/`in`/`nin`; multi-select uses `contains`/`ncontains`; option names resolve to IDs. Full operand rules are documented on `op`.

oneOf.description: Matches a row when every member matches.

all.description: Members combined with AND. An empty group is rejected, because it would compile to no filter at all.

items.description: A nested group, or a single condition.

field.description: Column name to compare, or one of the system fields `id`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt`.

op.description: Operators: `eq`, `ne`, `gt`, `gte`, `lt`, `lte`; `in`/`nin` take arrays; `isEmpty`, `isNotEmpty`, `isNull`, and `isNotNull` take no operand. Text operators are `contains`, `ncontains`, `startsWith`, `endsWith`, `like`, `nlike`, `ilike`, and `nilike`. Contains variants are case-insensitive and literal; `like`/`nlike` are case-sensitive, while `ilike`/`nilike` are case-insensitive. `*` is the only wildcard; `%`, `_`, and backslash are literal. For `select` columns, single-select accepts `eq`, `ne`, `in`, `nin`; multi-select accepts `contains`, `ncontains`. Option names resolve to IDs.

value.description: Operand. A scalar for the comparison operators, an array of at most 1000 entries for `in`/`nin`, a pattern for the matching operators, and omitted for `isEmpty`/`isNotEmpty`/`isNull`/`isNotNull`.

NonRootFolderPathInput.title: Non-root folder path input
NonRootFolderPathInput.description: Non-root folder path. A missing leading slash is normalized before validation. Segments are percent-encoded, so a folder shown as "New folder" is `/New%20folder`: everything outside `A-Z a-z 0-9 - _ . ~` is escaped as uppercase hex, and only that exact encoding is accepted. A trailing slash, an empty segment, and a literal `.` or `..` segment are rejected. At most 64 segments and 4096 encoded bytes.

rowIds.description: Explicit rows the dispatch targets. Absent means it was given no row list and walks every eligible row, narrowed by `filtered` and `excludeRowIds` when either is present.

filtered.description: Present and true when a stored filter narrows which rows run. The filter itself is not published: it is held compiled, in a different grammar from the predicate the request was written in. Absent means no filter narrows the dispatch — which, with no `rowIds` and no `excludeRowIds`, is what means every eligible row.

excludeRowIds.description: Rows the walk skips. Independent of `filtered`: a dispatch may exclude rows from a filtered set or from every eligible row. Never present alongside `rowIds`, which the run rejects and the walk would ignore.

scope.description: What the dispatch was asked to run.

limit.description: Cap on how much work the dispatch does, or null when unbounded.

isManualRun.description: True when a caller started the run, false for an automatic re-fire.
